category_title: Proficient multilingual learners who view dialogue as a means to provide academic help to peers
scenario_title: Peer dialogue and holding the right answer
minimal_context: Mateo is sitting with his group at an oval-shaped table to summarize key ideas from the chapter read the day prior.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your group at the table to summarize the key ideas from the chapter we read yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I already know the summary. It was hard ‘cuz like I didn’t know English, I couldn’t pronounce the words at first when I got here, but now I know it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, please discuss the chapter with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will. When I was in the Dominican Republic, I was in second grade. Then they gave me a test, but I failed the test, so I had to restart from kindergarten and then go up. Now I make sure I have the right answers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just make sure you are doing the group discussion.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am. If the person beside you understands it, probably like if I understand it and then the person next to me doesn’t understand it, you can help them understand it basically. I have the right answer so I will just give it to them.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please work with your group at the table to summarize the key ideas from the chapter we read yesterday.

STUDENT: I already know the summary. It was hard ‘cuz like I didn’t know English, I couldn’t pronounce the words at first when I got here, but now I know it.

TUTOR: Okay, please discuss the chapter with your group.

STUDENT: I will. When I was in the Dominican Republic, I was in second grade. Then they gave me a test, but I failed the test, so I had to restart from kindergarten and then go up. Now I make sure I have the right answers.

TUTOR: Just make sure you are doing the group discussion.

STUDENT: I am. If the person beside you understands it, probably like if I understand it and then the person next to me doesn’t understand it, you can help them understand it basically. I have the right answer so I will just give it to them.
